title: Mobile Pet Grooming in North Indianapolis | Bark & Mane

facts.fact: Bark & Mane's North Indianapolis location was brought to Indy in 2016 by owners Ken & Theresa.
facts.quote: Ken & Theresa brought Bark & Mane to Indy in 2016.

facts.fact: The North Indianapolis location lists the following areas as proudly served: Carmel, Cicero, Fishers, Fortville, Indianapolis, Ingalls, Mccordsville, Noblesville, Pendleton, Westfield, and Zionsville.
facts.quote: areas proudly served: Carmel, Cicero, Fishers, Fortville, Indianapolis, Ingalls, Mccordsville, Noblesville, Pendleton, Westfield, Zionsville

facts.fact: Bark & Mane states that its mobile grooming van is a full-service grooming van that arrives at the customer's driveway.
facts.quote: We'll arrive on time in our full-service grooming van, right to your driveway.

facts.fact: Bark & Mane offers dog grooming and cat grooming, and includes a Well-Being WrapUp™ with every session.
facts.quote: A comprehensive Well-Being WrapUp™ with every session

facts.fact: Bark & Mane's site states that the company was formerly named Aussie Pet Mobile and is now operating as Bark & Mane.
facts.quote: Aussie Pet Mobile is now Bark & Mane

facts.fact: Bark & Mane's SMS opt-in notice states that message and data rates may apply to its promotional text messages, and that customers can reply STOP to opt out.
facts.quote: Message & data rates may apply. Messaging frequency may vary. Please review our Privacy Policy
